name: Agents Pet
author: Gustavo Costa (gusthx)
description: A customizable flat pet for your Omarchy bar that follows your cursor and shares calm tips about your AI-agent usage, on top of the stock Agents panel.

barWidget.description: Agents panel with a sculptable pet: limits, pace, today and the last week for every AI subscription, plus usage tips.

schema.label: Companion name
schema.description: Default name for your pet (the editor in the panel overrides it).

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

schema.label: Show limits as
schema.description: Read each limit meter and its percentage as the share used or the share left. Alerts still follow the share used.

schema.label: Color-code limit meters
schema.description: Meters go green, yellow, orange and red from the theme's palette as usage climbs. Off keeps them in the bar's color, red near the cap.

schema.label: Show pace on limit meters
schema.description: A tick where usage would be at an even pace, an arrow (ahead, on track, under) and, on hover, where that pace leads by the reset.

schema.label: Limits the pet's mood watches
schema.description: Which limits can make the pet worried (one you are using crossing 90%, for ten minutes, or all of them at 90%) or out of breath: all of them (Auto), or only the session or only the weekly ones. A provider without the chosen kind keeps all of its own. Tired always means every subscription is capped.

schema.label: Show what to use first
schema.description: Rank your subscriptions by how much of each weekly quota would go unused at its reset, under "Use first" in the panel while one of them would go partly unused. It measures your recent pace from a small local history of fresh limit readings (25 hours at most), which the pet's mood also uses to tell which subscriptions are in use.

schema.label: Recent pace window (hours)
schema.description: How many hours of recent use the forecast weighs against the cycle's average. Longer smooths out bursts.

schema.label: Urgent when unused is at least (%)
schema.description: A quota is urgent when at least this share is projected to go unused...

schema.label: Pet gets hungry over urgent quota
schema.description: The pet looks hungry while a quota is urgent, below worried, tired and out of breath.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: The pet sends a desktop notice when a limit reaches the threshold below, an urgent one when it is then used up, and one when a Codex free reset is about to expire. Once per crossing; readings from before the plugin started stay quiet.

schema.label: Notify at (% used)
schema.description: A limit notifies once when its usage reaches this share, and again only after it drops 7 points below or a new window starts.
